title: OTInstaller result envelope, version 1
description: What `ot run` prints for one run. Fields are only ever added within version 1, so readers must ignore keys they don't know.

tool.description: The package that ran, as namespace/name@version.

input.description: The resolved inputs, by input name.

exit_code.description: The tool's own exit code; ot's exit code is separate.

raw.description: The tool's output parsed by its output_format: JSON for json, an array for jsonl, an array of row objects for csv, otherwise a string. null when left out (see output.raw_omitted).

run_id.description: Identifies this run; it is also part of the saved file names.

client.description: What started the run: a person or script (cli), a CI system (ci), or an MCP client (mcp).

ref.description: The image reference pinned by digest, or the wheel's SHA-256.

signer.description: The cosign certificate identity the image was verified against, when it was.

from_backup.description: Installed from the registry's mirror or wheel copy.

output.description: The tool's stdout as produced, before parsing.

path.description: Where the run was saved, unless --no-save.

raw_omitted.description: true when raw was left out because the output was larger than --max-raw (or OT_MAX_RAW). The saved file is complete.

type.description: Usually one of the manifest's output types: https://otinstaller.com/schema/v1.json#/$defs/entityType

source.description: The site or service the entity came from.
